name: motvin
description: Search real product UI from shipped apps: screens and step-by-step flows from iOS apps, web apps and marketing websites.

interface.longDescription: Motvin is a library of real product UI — screens and step-by-step flows captured from shipped iOS apps, web apps and marketing websites. Ask in plain words, such as "paywalls with an annual toggle" or "fintech onboarding", and ChatGPT finds matching screens, shows a preview of each, walks through whole flows, and compares how real apps solve the same problem. Every search stays on one platform (iOS, web app or website) so results are never mixed. Motvin only reads the design library; it never changes anything in your account. A free Motvin account is needed, and you sign in once in the browser when you connect.
capabilities: Find screens by the words printed on them
Show a screen's full details and preview
Find screens similar to one you like
defaultPrompt: Search Motvin for onboarding screens from fintech apps on iOS
Show me 5 paywalls and tell me what they have in common
How do food apps handle checkout? Walk me through a real flow

positive.description: Search screens by description on one platform
positive.prompt: Search Motvin for paywall screens on iOS
positive.expected_behavior: Returns iOS paywall screens from several apps, each with a preview image, the app name and a link to the screen on motvin.com.

positive.prompt: Show me a real onboarding flow from an iOS app on Motvin, step by step
positive.expected_behavior: Finds an iOS onboarding flow and lists its steps in order with a preview of each step.

positive.description: Find screens by the words on them
positive.prompt: Find web app screens on Motvin that say "cancel anytime"
positive.expected_behavior: Returns web app screens whose visible text contains "cancel anytime", with the app name and a preview.

positive.prompt: Search Motvin for login screens on iOS and show me the full details of the first one
positive.expected_behavior: Returns iOS login screens, then the first screen's description, UI elements and a larger preview.

positive.description: Browse the apps in the library
positive.prompt: Which iOS apps does Motvin have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists iOS apps in the Motvin library with their names and how many screens and flows each has.

negative.description: Unrelated request that needs no Motvin tool
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Asks to change or delete data, which Motvin cannot do
negative.prompt: Delete all my saved Motvin collections

negative.description: General writing task with no design reference needed
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the ocean

review.commerce_description: Motvin does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: search screens and flows from real iOS apps, web apps and websites.
